mutants.name: perceus-transform-skips-mayfail-arena-reset
mutants.rule: Every OpReturn including early mayFail unwind exits must emit OpArenaReset when frame arena is active.

mutants.name: perceus-verify-misses-double-free
mutants.rule: Operational verifier must fail immediately with ErrDoubleFree when dropping rc <= 0.

mutants.name: perceus-verify-misses-dangling-arena
mutants.rule: Operational verifier must fail immediately with ErrDanglingArena on reads after OpArenaReset.

mutants.name: perceus-verify-misses-leak-exit
mutants.rule: Operational verifier must fail with ErrMemoryLeak when live RC exceeds expected returned references.

mutants.name: perceus-verify-own-reuse-aliases-live
mutants.rule: A static own reuse of a token whose object another live value still holds would alias that value: the verifier refuses it.

mutants.name: perceus-arena-scope-misses-later-alloc
mutants.rule: A block-local arena scope ends after the last arena allocation in it, not only after the last read.

mutants.name: perceus-fromir-join-drops-args
mutants.from: EmitBr(&lw.b, lw.cur, BranchTarget{Block: target, Args: slices.Clone(lw.vals)})
mutants.rule: A jump to a join passes one argument per local, the local's current value.

mutants.name: perceus-fromir-else-sees-then-values
mutants.rule: The else branch starts from the locals' values before the if, not the then branch's.

mutants.name: perceus-fromir-skips-expression

mutants.name: perceus-fromir-references-uncounted
